rule.schema_supported: Ship only an opt-in GalaxieLM schema_output keyword when default behavior, schema forwarding, fixed refusals, routing, typed validation and replay all pass native and Node gates.
rule.schema_alternative: If the mapping needs bridge, router or existing assertion changes, keep typed reply validation or pydantic-ai NativeOutput as the alternative.
rule.schema_refused: Refuse any mapping that changes defaults, leaks author text in errors or silently drops constraints.
rule.branch_accepted: Accept the existing overlap limit if a per-branch asyncio.Lock preserves marks, checkpoints and replay, including one awaited helper task.
rule.branch_handle: If only the test-local handle passes, stop: shipping a handle needs a separate public API decision and plan.
rule.branch_refused: If neither recipe nor candidate passes, record the evidence and preserve the existing limit.

predictions.P1: Default GalaxieLM stays unchanged; pe-schema-response-format remains unsupported with zero requests.
predictions.P2: The native JSONAdapter twin emits a strict json_schema response_format.
predictions.P3: Opt-in JSONAdapter forwards exactly the native schema as options.jsonSchema.
predictions.P4: Explicit response_format=Model forwards the same schema.
predictions.P5: Open dict json_object output is unsupported before dispatch.
predictions.P6: Schema beside tools is unsupported before dispatch.
predictions.P7: Schema streaming is unsupported before dispatch.
predictions.P8: A route without structured-output ends unavailable with zero provider calls.
predictions.P9: Typed violations end executor_error after one request without retry.
predictions.P10: Restore replays without redispatch; a changed schema ends unrecoverable.
predictions.P11: The lock recipe preserves marks and checkpoint bytes under reversed hop timing and permits one awaited helper task.
predictions.P12: The test-local owner guard refuses a concurrent second entry before its dispatch and permits one awaited helper task; only guarded calls are protected.

vocabulary.PASS: The lane ran and matched the assertion.
vocabulary.DIVERGED: The lane ran and differed; retain the first failure and register the exact engine title.
vocabulary.NOT RUN: The lane did not complete; state the cause.
vocabulary.EXISTING: Earlier recorded evidence, not a measurement in this run.
vocabulary.UNMEASURED: Outside the measured scope; state the cause.

unmeasured.real_models: No model access; scripted parity does not establish provider enforcement.
unmeasured.root_call_guards: No root-call guard experiment is included.
unmeasured.worker_task_identity: Branch recipe is measured on native CPython and Node Pyodide only.
unmeasured.react_schema_replay: Only a bounded schema-call replay is measured.
unmeasured.other_dspy_versions: Only the installed pinned DSPy version is exercised.
